name: Cubox Ext
description:
Cubox Ext mirrors your browser bookmarks to your Cubox library, one-way and in real time. Bookmarks are the source of truth: every create, remove, change, and move triggers a debounced 2-second reconciliation that uploads the diff to your Cubox `sync` folder. Runs entirely in the background — closing the popup does not stop sync.

**What it does**
• Watches bookmarks events and syncs the delta to Cubox in the background.
• Performs a full reconciliation on startup, install, and when you change your API key.
• Dedupes against your full Cubox library by URL before saving, so no duplicate cards.
• Verifies saved cards via progressive back-checks (1.5s / 2.5s / 4s / 6s) and retries lost ones within a budget.
• Popup: paste your API key once and click to save the current page to Cubox.
• Duplicate URL? You get an OS notification — non-blocking, auto-dismissing, no page focus steal.

**How to use**
1. Click the toolbar icon, paste your Cubox API key, save the key.
2. Add a bookmark (or use the popup button to save the current page) — it appears in Cubox within seconds.
3. Existing Cubox cards are not modified; deletions in your browser remove the matching card from Cubox.

**Privacy**
This extension makes HTTPS requests only to https://cubox.pro using your API key. It collects nothing else, stores nothing else, and does not track you. The Firefox data-collection declaration (browser_specific_settings.gecko.data_collection_permissions) is set to ["none"].
